consequence.statement: The istio-base chart now templates the Istio CRDs, so `helm upgrade istio-base` upgrades them, and the CRD labels change to be consistent with other Helm-installed resources. Existing `kubectl apply` installs and upgrades can continue.
consequence.remediation: Check whether you want to manage the Istio CRDs with `helm upgrade istio-base` from now on. If you do, review the CRD label change. If not, keep using `kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml`.
